title: Simulation and Optimization of Designs and Flows
description: Simulation and optimization tools for modeling design performance and configuring designs and operation modes. Numerical and analytical simulation, machine learning methods, meta-heuristic optimization (e.g. genetic algorithms) and linear programming. Literature and Python-based computational tools are applied to a specific problem; results are assessed and communicated in a conference-style paper.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CIVE 503, CIVE 580 (if taken in the same topic).
